name: Task profiles
do: Write precip-nowcast.v1 (variable, layout, time, missing)
done_when: A data package can offer it without this owner decoding files

name: Matcher
do: offers ∩ requires, then shape/cadence/frames. Human-readable errors
done_when: Incompatible pairs never reach the runner

name: Shared contracts
do: Types Protocol manifest parse. No IO
done_when: Implementations depend only on this package plus their own files

name: Data adapter interface
do: Protocol list/load/offers/close. Manifest schema. Fake-adapter tests
done_when: New dataset = new datas/PACKAGE_ID/ without editing B1

name: Data catalog mount
do: NIB_DATA_ROOT layout. Missing-path error before run
done_when: Several implementations coexist on one mount

name: SEVIR VIL
do: datas/SEVIR implements B1. Offer precip-nowcast.v1
done_when: Matcher accepts SEVIR with current models

name: Local radar
do: datas/PACKAGE_ID for ODIM / national composite. Same job as SEVIR
done_when: Pairs through Matcher; B1 not edited

name: Satellite
do: datas/PACKAGE_ID implementing B1. Sat-to-radar stays in this package if needed
done_when: Offers are honest

name: Lightning
do: datas/PACKAGE_ID implementing B1
done_when: Loads and declares offers

name: Model adapter interface
do: Protocol predict(TaskSample). Manifest requires/input/output. Fake-model tests
done_when: New model = new models/PACKAGE_ID/ without editing C1

name: WADEPre
do: Adapter + ONNX. Owns 6-to-5 frames and training-time norm
done_when: predict() matches contract

name: NowcastNet
do: Adapter + artifact implementing C1
done_when: Same bar as C2

name: SimVP
do: Adapter + artifact implementing C1
done_when: Same bar as C2

name: exPreCast
do: Adapter + artifact implementing C1
done_when: Same bar as C2

name: Evaluation
do: Metrics from saved arrays. Thresholds change without rerunning inference
done_when: Changing CSI does not start ONNX

name: Visualization
do: Registry by variable/product. vil-frames is one renderer
done_when: A new variable registers without editing SEVIR

name: Artifacts
do: Standard result dir. Failed runs stay inspectable
done_when: Failed run opens in the UI

name: Control service
do: Catalog scan, Matcher, one child run, SSE
done_when: UI never imports an adapter

name: Runner
do: One process. Calls implementations through B1/C1. NIB_PROGRESS
done_when: Truncation/norm only inside a model adapter
depends_on: A2 B1 C1 D1 D2 D3

name: Workflow config
do: Strict YAML v2
done_when: Hand-written YAML starts a run

name: Web UI
do: Select, run, compare. Hide Matcher-rejected pairs
done_when: Browser never starts Docker

name: Compose / launcher
do: Image, port, read-only mount, workspace volume
done_when: Docker + NIB_DATA_ROOT starts the box
